title: Skew Constacyclic Codes Of Length $np^s$ over $ \frac{\mathbb{F}_{p^m}[u]}{\langle u^k \rangle}
summary: Let $\mathbb{F}_{p^m}$ be the field containing $p^m$ elements where $p$ is an odd prime and $m \in \mathbb{N}$. In this article, we propose a unified approach to the study of skew constacyclic codes of length $np^s$ over the ring $R_k = \mathbb{F}_{p^m}[u]/\langle u^k \rangle,$ where $n, s, k \in \mathbb{N}$ and $\gcd(n, p)=1$. Consider the skew polynomial ring $R_k[x;Θ]$, where $Θ$ is an automorphism of $R_k$ such that $xa = Θ(a)x$ for all $a \in R_k$.
